fullTextEN: Hello everyone!
I am Yvonne.

fullTextZH: 这里是泰国清迈的一个农场。
fullTextEN: This is a farm in Chiang Mai, Thailand.
I really like it here.
So today I want to

fullTextZH: 分享我在这个农场的生活。
fullTextEN: share my life on this farm.
This place,
It has an area that is a tent area.
This is the tent area.
There are four tents here.
And this is my home.
This is my tent.
They also have this kind of house,
a house made of bamboo.

fullTextZH: 我也很喜欢这种用竹子做的房子。
fullTextEN: I also really like this kind of house made of bamboo.

fullTextZH: 但是因为我很想住在帐篷里面，
fullTextEN: But because I really want to live in a tent,

fullTextZH: 所以这次的住宿我选帐篷。
fullTextEN: so this time I chose a tent for accommodation.
Let's get a little closer to take a look.
Do you like this kind of accommodation,
this kind of house?
This is my tent.

fullTextZH: 来，我开门带你们进去看看。
fullTextEN: Come, I'll open the door and take you in to have a look.

fullTextZH: 你们看，里面有一个很大的床垫哎！
fullTextEN: Look, there's a big mattress inside!
This mattress,
It has a bit of thickness.
It's not too thin,
and it's quite soft,

fullTextZH: 不是那一种很硬的床垫。
fullTextEN: not the kind of very hard mattress.
This is my small table.
Isn't it cute?

fullTextZH: 上面我放了芒果、橘子、墨镜。
fullTextEN: On top, I placed mangoes, oranges, and sunglasses.
And this,
I bought this,
a bowl made from coconut.

fullTextZH: 那里面我放了我的牙刷跟牙膏。
fullTextEN: Inside, I put my toothbrush and toothpaste.

fullTextZH: 然后这里是我可以晾衣服的地方。
fullTextEN: And here is where I can hang clothes.

fullTextZH: 我可以把我的衣服晾在树枝上。
fullTextEN: I can hang my clothes on the branches.

fullTextZH: 还有一个粉红色很漂亮的灯。
fullTextEN: There's also a very pretty pink lamp.

fullTextZH: 我拿了一个东西到我的帐篷。
fullTextEN: I took something to my tent.
Do you know what this is?
This thing is called mosquito coil.
Now I am lighting a mosquito coil.

fullTextZH: 因为这里有太多蚊子了，
fullTextEN: Because there are too many mosquitoes here,
so I need to light a mosquito coil,

fullTextZH: 让那些蚊子不要靠近我。
fullTextEN: to keep those mosquitoes away from me.
Now everything is organized,
let's take a break.
I am peeling an orange.
This orange is so sweet and delicious!
I look very happy,
because I am really happy.
Ah, this mango is also very fragrant!

fullTextZH: 现在我们去看看这个农场
fullTextEN: Now let's go take a look at this farm

fullTextZH: 还有什么其他的地方吧。
fullTextEN: and see what other places there are.

fullTextZH: 这间房子也是用竹子做的哦！
fullTextEN: This house is also made of bamboo!
This is the place for bathing.
I always bathe here.

fullTextZH: 这是一个户外的洗澡的地方，
fullTextEN: This is an outdoor bathing place,
I really love it!
But there is only cold water here,
There is no hot water.
There is a sink here,
a place to wash dishes and hands.
Next to it is a big table,
used for drying dishes,
a place to dry cups.
This is my new friend,
called Federico.
He is cutting some vegetables.
This is another friend,
called Basa.
He is eating his dinner.
Ha, he sees me filming him.
So this is the outdoor kitchen.
We have two stoves.
So we all need to use wood,

fullTextZH: 我们要用木头生火才可以煮饭。
fullTextEN: We need to use wood to make a fire to cook.
Just like this.

fullTextZH: 现在我的朋友他在生火。
fullTextEN: Now my friend is making a fire.

fullTextZH: 他用一些木头还有竹子生火。
fullTextEN: He uses some wood and bamboo to make a fire.
As for me, I use my hands to help start the fire.
Now we can cook.

fullTextZH: 旁边这个小灯突然亮了。
fullTextEN: The small lamp next to us suddenly lit up.

fullTextZH: 好美哦，这个灯真的好美！
fullTextEN: So beautiful, this lamp is really beautiful!
I really like this feeling.

fullTextZH: 在户外跟朋友一边煮饭一边聊天。
fullTextEN: Cooking and chatting with friends outdoors.

fullTextZH: 虽然我们来自不同国家，
fullTextEN: Although we come from different countries,
the food we eat is also different,

fullTextZH: 但是我们可以一起分享我们的快乐。
fullTextEN: but we can share our happiness together.

fullTextZH: 再继续带你们看看其他的地方。
fullTextEN: Let's continue to show you other places.
This is the campfire area.

fullTextZH: 晚上的时候我们会在这里生火，
fullTextEN: In the evening, we will make a fire here,
and then everyone will sit here,
like this.
I heard mosquitoes are afraid of smoke,

fullTextZH: 所以我们都坐在营火的旁边吃饭呢、
fullTextEN: so we all sit next to the campfire to eat,
and chat.

fullTextZH: 我们还会一起玩音乐，你们听。
fullTextEN: We also play music together, listen.
Good morning!

fullTextZH: 我们的火鸡已经起床了。
fullTextEN: Our turkey is already awake.

fullTextZH: 它的叫声很好笑对不对？
fullTextEN: Its call is very funny, isn't it?
In the morning,
I will work here,
I have classes here.
Hello, kitty!

fullTextZH: 他在这里陪我一起工作。
fullTextEN: He works here with me.

fullTextZH: 他们还有4只刚出生的小猫小baby。
fullTextEN: They also have 4 newborn kittens.
Wow, they are really super cute!

fullTextZH: 他们好像才两个星期大。
fullTextEN: They seem to be only two weeks old.
They were born just two weeks ago.

fullTextZH: 我每次去看它们的时候，
fullTextEN: Every time I go to see them,
I feel like I'm about to melt,
because they are too cute.
Look at those eyes,
Its eyes,
and its little nose.
Oh, really super cute!
Then when not working,

fullTextZH: 我会到这边这个地方休息，
fullTextEN: I will rest at this place here,

fullTextZH: 或是做一些其他的事情。
fullTextEN: or do some other things.

fullTextZH: 像今天我在这里写日记。
fullTextEN: Like today, I am here writing a diary.

fullTextZH: 有时候头脑里有很多想法，
fullTextEN: Sometimes there are many thoughts in my mind,
There are many feelings,
I then need to write a diary,
Write them down.
Sometimes I also chat with some
new friends here.
She is my new friend,
Her name is Tina.

fullTextZH: 我们喜欢聊一些比较深的话题。
fullTextEN: We like to discuss some deeper topics.

fullTextZH: 我觉得我在这里认识的人，
fullTextEN: I feel the people I meet here,

fullTextZH: 大家都很喜欢聊一些比较深的话题。
fullTextEN: everyone likes to discuss some deeper topics.
I took a book,

fullTextZH: 我想说可以在这个吊床上看书。
fullTextEN: I thought I could read on this hammock.

fullTextZH: 可是，可是这个吊床它、它很难上去哎！
fullTextEN: But, but this hammock, it's hard to get on!

fullTextZH: 你们看我卡在这里很久。
fullTextEN: You see, I've been stuck here for a long time.
Then after I got on,

fullTextZH: 这个吊床就一直摇、一直摇来摇去。
fullTextEN: this hammock kept swinging back and forth.

fullTextZH: 我不知道怎么控制这个吊床，
fullTextEN: I don't know how to control this hammock,

fullTextZH: 我不知道怎么让这个吊床停下来。
fullTextEN: I don't know how to make this hammock stop.
It just keeps shaking.

fullTextZH: 我觉得自己有一点好笑，
fullTextEN: I feel a little funny,
And I also want to say, ah,
Forget it, forget it,
Because it's really not very comfortable,
So I came down.
Sometimes,

fullTextZH: 我会躺在我的帐篷外面，
fullTextEN: I would lie outside my tent,
Playing this harmonica.

fullTextZH: 这个是我的一个新朋友他的口琴。
fullTextEN: This is a harmonica from my new friend.

fullTextZH: 我在这里认识的新朋友，
fullTextEN: A new friend I met here,
They are all very interesting!

fullTextZH: 他们在旅行的时候都会带着乐器，
fullTextEN: They always bring instruments when traveling,

fullTextZH: 这样他们在认识新朋友的时候，
fullTextEN: So when they meet new friends,

fullTextZH: 就可以跟新朋友分享音乐啊，
fullTextEN: They can share music with new friends,

fullTextZH: 大家就可以一起玩音乐。
fullTextEN: Everyone can play music together.

fullTextZH: 没错，有时候我也会去打泰拳。
fullTextEN: That's right, sometimes I also go to practice Muay Thai.
Muay Thai is very famous in Thailand.

fullTextZH: 其实这是我第一次去啦，
fullTextEN: Actually, this is my first time going,

fullTextZH: 所以我看起来看起来很不会打对不对？
fullTextEN: So I look like I can't fight, right?
But I think it's very fun,

fullTextZH: 以后我也会想继续去上泰拳课。
fullTextEN: In the future, I would also like to continue attending Muay Thai classes.

fullTextZH: 我们的农场附近有一个当地的市场。
fullTextEN: There is a local market near our farm.

fullTextZH: 这边大部分都是当地人才会来的，
fullTextEN: Most people here are locals who come,
There aren't many tourists.

fullTextZH: 这个椰子果昔超好喝的，
fullTextEN: This coconut smoothie is super delicious,
and it's very cheap.

fullTextZH: 还有卖一些当地的小吃。
fullTextEN: They also sell some local snacks.
They put them all in boxes.

fullTextZH: 你们看，这个就是泰国很有名的Pad Thai。
fullTextEN: Look, this is the famous Thai Pad Thai.
And this is a fried spring roll.
Then on the left are squares,

fullTextZH: 一块一块的东西也很好吃。
fullTextEN: pieces that are also very tasty.
In Thai markets,
they also sell sushi,
and it's very cheap.
And this is fried insects,
fried bugs.
I don't want to eat!
And there's a little boy,
He plays guitar inside the market.
I think it's really cool!
In the evening,
I will turn on the light,
sit outside my tent,
and do some other things.
Maybe I'll write a diary,
or draw,
or play guitar.
See what I want to do,
and I'll do it.

fullTextZH: 就是一个让自己安静下来的时间。
fullTextEN: It's just a time to calm myself down.
This cat jumped onto my desk,
It wants me to pet it.

fullTextZH: 好啦，摸你一下，摸你一下。
fullTextEN: Alright, pet you once, pet you once.
It's really so cute!

fullTextZH: 好啦，这就是我在农场的生活。
fullTextEN: Alright, this is my life on the farm.

fullTextZH: 我真的很喜欢很喜欢这个农场。
fullTextEN: I really, really like this farm.

fullTextZH: 我有了好多好美的回忆，
fullTextEN: I have so many beautiful memories,

fullTextZH: 也认识了好多很有趣的新朋友。
fullTextEN: and I've met many interesting new friends.

fullTextZH: 你们会想要来这个地方吗？
fullTextEN: Would you like to come to this place?

fullTextZH: 或是你们喜欢这样的地方吗？
fullTextEN: Or do you like places like this?

fullTextZH: 欢迎你们在下面跟大家分享哦！
fullTextEN: You're welcome to share with everyone below!

fullTextZH: 那我跟猫咪就要跟大家说再见喽！
fullTextEN: Then the cat and I will say goodbye to everyone!
Bye-bye!
